cards.name: Elspeth, Storm Slayer
cards.oracle_text:
If one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.
+1: Create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
0: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Those creatures gain flying until your next turn.
−3: Destroy target creature an opponent controls with mana value 3 or greater.

cards.name: Strategic Betrayal
cards.oracle_text: Target opponent exiles a creature they control and their graveyard.

cards.name: Archenemy's Charm
cards.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Exile target creature or planeswalker.
• Return one or two target creature and/or planeswalker cards from your graveyard to your hand.
• Put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. It gains lifelink until end of turn.
